description: Confirm the events behind automations: for a Mixpanel integration, each mapped event with its Mixpanel source events and their 7-day volume, how many reached TextKit and when the last did, and which automations start on, wait for or check it. `missing` names events automations rely on that nothing sends. project_events: true also lists every Mixpanel event name with its 7-day volume, to choose what to map.

project_events.description: Also list the Mixpanel project's event names with their 7-day volume.

name: get_integration_events
title: Get integration events
